pokedexEntries.rb: When it swings its burning tail, it elevates the temperature to unbearably high levels.

pokedexEntries.ye: Tough fights could excite this POKéMON. When excited, it may blow out bluish-white flames.

pokedexEntries.go: It is very hotheaded by nature, so it constantly seeks opponents. It calms down only when it wins.

pokedexEntries.si: It has a barbaric nature. In battle, it whips its fiery tail around and slashes away with sharp claws.

pokedexEntries.cr: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.

pokedexEntries.rs: CHARMELEON mercilessly destroys its foes using its sharp claws. If it encounters a strong foe, it turns aggressive. In this excited state, the flame at the tip of its tail flares with a bluish white color.

pokedexEntries.fr: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.

pokedexEntries.lg: When it swings its burning tail, it elevates the air temperature to unbearably high levels.

pokedexEntries.em: Without pity, its sharp claws destroy foes. If it encounters a strong enemy, it becomes agitated, and the flame on its tail flares with a bluish white color.

pokedexEntries.dpp: In the rocky mountains where CHARMELEON live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.
